tools.name: landing.search
tools.description: Submit a job search from the homepage search bar. The page navigates to the job search results. Both fields are optional: an empty title matches any title and an empty location matches any location.

title.description: Job title or keywords to search for, e.g. "Software Engineer". Empty matches any title.

location.description: Location to search in, e.g. "Santa Monica, CA". Empty matches any location.
